subject.title: fix(ui): make stale-chunk Reload survive the gateway restart

question: Should OpenClaw’s autoreview workflow intentionally replace fail-closed handling of sensitive review inputs with redaction-and-omission, or must that behavior remain out of this UI bug-fix PR?
rationale: The changed behavior affects the security boundary and completeness guarantees of automated code review, which cannot be accepted as incidental implementation detail in a stale-chunk UI repair.

options.title: Split and retain fail-closed behavior
options.body: Remove the autoreview and changelog changes from this PR, then review any secret-handling policy change separately with dedicated security evidence.

options.title: Sponsor a dedicated policy change
options.body: Keep the UI fix separate and open a maintainer-owned review of redact-and-omit behavior, including its threat model and disclosure guarantees.

recommendation.title: Split and retain fail-closed behavior
recommendation.body: Remove the autoreview and changelog changes from this PR, then review any secret-handling policy change separately with dedicated security evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: The available PR evidence ties this contributor to both the UI fix and the coupled autoreview change; a maintainer with ownership of autoreview policy should make the final decision.
